text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
King Hassan denounces Israeli tunnel opening in Jerusalem as provocative act affecting Arabs and Moslems which flagrantly violates all international resolutions.
Morocco made great progress, says World Bank report covering July 1995 to June 1996.
"Israel - terrorist state" - Morocco condemns Israeli repression which has resulted in many Palestinian martyrs.
Middle East peace process no longer sees the end of the tunnel. "Black Friday" in Jerusalem.
Officials of Johannesburg and Rabat chambers of commerce determined to strengthen cooperation between Morocco and South Africa, especially in trade and industry.
Israeli government must assume responsibility for the bloodbath into which it has plunged the Palestinian territories.
Maghreb-Europe gas pipeline will go on stream in October, with commercial operations planned for 1 November.
Partnerships and sub-contracting are essential steps to revitalise Morocco's national industrial fabric.
